Lemma
[The Ambient Metric Along a Submanifold]

↗ def:smooth-field-scalar-products

If $g$ is a smooth field of scalar products on $V\to B$ and $F:B'\to B$ is smooth, then $(F^*g)_x=g_{F(x)}$ is a smooth field of scalar products on $F^*V$.
Proof

↗ def:smooth-field-scalar-products \sketch Symmetry and nondegeneracy hold fibrewise. In pulled-back trivializations, the coordinate field is the smooth coordinate field of $g$ composed with $F$.

□
